data.narrative:
NuScale Power operates in the nuclear energy sector at the public stage, having raised over $600M in total funding. The addressable peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies across nuclear energy: 3 public peers (trading under tickers OKLO, NNE, and SMR) and 7 private competitors including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The nuclear energy sector contains only six same-sector peers, but filtering by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier yields insufficient datapoints (fewer than three required for statistical reliability). Applying an all-sector median would introduce misleading bias given the specialized capital intensity and regulatory environment of nuclear technology development. No triangulated valuation range can therefore be responsibly derived from peer multiples alone.

Completing a defensible valuation of NuScale requires application of alternative methods not present in the available data—such as discounted cash flow analysis tied to project pipelines and deployment timelines, precedent transaction multiples from recent nuclear or energy infrastructure M&A, or sum-of-the-parts analysis disaggregating reactor development, licensing, and manufacturing segments. Key uncertainties include regulatory approval timelines, manufacturing scale-up costs, and utility adoption rates for small modular reactors, each of which materially affect intrinsic value. A comprehensive analysis would require detailed financial projections and market adoption assumptions beyond the peer set alone.
